title: Life Steal Plugin
description:
A simple lifesteal plugin.

This is a lifesteal plugin that when you kill a person you gain 1 heart and the person you kill loses 1 heart.

Yes, this is still working on, i will add more features so on. Any bugs can be reported in my Discord.
body:
A lifesteal plugin 

Lifesteal Plugin is a lifesteal plugin where if you kill a player you get 1 heart from them and they lose a heart. 

**Note: This is a Beta version, so it is currently in testing and not confirmed to work on other 1.21.x versions, any issues can be reported in the discord!**
